value.name: variant_external_id
value.purpose: the specific variant that restocked; null for product-level items

value.name: cycle_key
value.purpose: stable dedup key combining product, variant, and the calendar date of the restock, preventing duplicate cycles from concurrent webhook deliveries on the same day

value.name: available_quantity
value.purpose: units available at restock, bounding how many front-of-queue subscribers are notified this cycle

value.name: detected_at
value.purpose: when this restock was first observed; new restock only opens after stock had dropped to zero again

value.name: notified_count
value.purpose: how many subscribers have been emailed in this cycle so far

edits.value: Send notify-pending emails whose quiet-hours window has now passed, sourcing the work set from waitlist subscriptions in notify-pending status whose quiet-hours window has expired.
